source: Seven days, one book, a plan you can keep.
Day one: read the first hour out loud. Your voice catches what your eyes skim.
Day two: write three questions. A question you cannot answer is worth keeping.
Day three: reread only the pages you marked.
Day four: argue with the author. Write the disagreement in one sentence.
Day five: teach one idea to someone. If you cannot, you have not read it.
Day six: write the whole book in one sentence.
Day seven: keep the book or leave it. Both answers are honest.
